notes.title: Marlon's Mystery update: v1.2
notes.content:
Greetings detectives! 

Abby and Jared have been itching to bring you a new challenge, and in this new version they have made the ACHIEVEMENTS available to you.

They have also repaired Jared's grandma's old car and are ready for new operating systems (MacOS and Linux versions).

We hope you enjoy the new version.

Made in Mavis

notes.title: Marlon's Mystery patch 1.1.5
notes.content:
Hello, sharp detectives

A false clue had slipped through the code and we've had to put Abby and Jared on the case.
With this patch, the cursor should no longer disappear after using the board.
Thanks for your messages and enjoy the mysteries.

Made in Mavis 🔎
